environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with direct PostgreSQL 15 connection (no connection pooler). Service connects to RDS PostgreSQL on port 5432 directly. Network policy allows egress to RDS subnet. No query-level firewall or middleware between application and database. DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://rds-instance.cluster-xyz.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:5432/appdb

config.network: EKS pod -> RDS direct on port 5432
